post.caption:
3 things to stop doing if you want to grow 🌱

I. Stop waiting to feel ready. Start, and readiness will follow.
II. "Don't compare your beginning to someone else's middle." — Jon Acuff
III. Stop saying yes to everything. Every yes is a no to something else.

Which one are you stopping today? I, II or III 👇
Save this for the day you need it. 🤍

youtube.description:
3 things to stop doing if you want to grow.

I. Stop waiting to feel ready. Start, and readiness will follow.
Confidence doesn't come before action. It comes from it.

II. "Don't compare your beginning to someone else's middle." — Jon Acuff
You're seeing their chapter 20. You're on chapter 1. That's fine.

III. Stop saying yes to everything. Every yes is a no to something else.
Protect your time like it matters, because it does.

Which one are you stopping today? Comment I, II or III.
